subject: PulseCare: staggered project enablement + renewal term coordination
messages:
From: Tamara Chen <tamara@pulsecare.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Expansion request + renewal term question

Hi Stephanie / Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had an internal readout and there is strong interest in rolling Redwood out beyond the initial integration team. High-level ask: we want to add three additional product teams over the next two quarters (CareOps, Intake, and Analytics) and will need separate API keys and a staged rollout plan.

A couple of questions up-front while we get staging slots scheduled:
- If we add projects now, how will that affect our upcoming annual renewal? Can we lock pricing for the expanded seat count or do we handle additional usage as overage?
- We also need predictable capacity for batch inference during analytics runs — can you recommend a dedicated capacity plan or burst strategy?

Attached is a draft SOW and a simple roster of the teams (PulseCare_SOW_v2.pdf; Project-Roster.xlsx). Procurement will join on the next thread.

Goal: firm up an onboarding cadence and propose how expansion ties into the renewal (we prefer to avoid multiple contract amendments if possible).

Thanks,
Tamara Chen
Director of Product, PulseCare

---
Attachments: PulseCare_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), Project-Roster.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tamara Chen <tamara@pulsecare.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request + renewal term question

Hi Tamara —

Really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW + roster — this is straightforward to scope. Quick answers before we set up a call with Procurement:

1) Renewal & pricing: we can do two approaches depending on your preference:
   - Consolidated amendment: fold the additional teams into the annual renewal (recommended if you want price certainty and a single contract instrument).
   - Incremental addendum: add them now as temporary keys and bill as overage until the renewal window, then consolidate.

2) Capacity: for the Analytics team's batch runs I recommend a small Dedicated pool with scheduled burst windows. That gives predictable latency for large jobs while keeping host costs lower for steady-state traffic. We can model expected token volume if you share typical batch sizes.

Next step: Jordan can run a quick capacity forecast and I can draft a sample amendment language that ties the new projects to the renewal. Available slots for a joint sync with Procurement: Thu 6/3 9–11am PT or Mon 6/7 10–12pm PT. Which works?

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request + renewal term question

Tamara / Stephanie —

Thanks — I ran a quick token/throughput sketch based on the roster and some conservative assumptions for CareOps and Analytics. High-level:
- Steady-state: ~5M tokens/month across the 3 new teams (low concurrency).
- Batch windows: Analytics peak jobs ~2–3 hours, near 120–150 concurrent streams for short bursts.

Recommendations:
- Dedicated small pool (2x A100-equivalent) with an autoscale policy that allows 3x burst capacity for scheduled windows. That keeps tail latency predictable and reduces per-token cost by ~22% vs hosted burst pricing.
- Provision 6 developer keys for staged rollout (one per team + two for integration/testing). We can gate production keys until the final training/validation pass is complete.

I attached a short summary and a sample amendment outline we can use to add the teams to the renewal and lock pricing (PulseCare_renewal-summary-0609.pdf). If Procurement prefers, we can do a phased rollback where only the Analytics team is on Dedicated initially.

Happy to walk through the numbers on the call.

—Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts

Attachments: PulseCare_renewal-summary-0609.pdf (pdf)

From: Tamara Chen <tamara@pulsecare.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PulseCare Procurement <procurement@pulsecare.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request + renewal term question

Stephanie / Jordan —

Thanks for the fast turn. Procurement reviewed Jordan's summary and prefers the consolidated amendment approach to avoid multiple contract changes. They asked that we:
- Confirm final count of production keys (PulseCare proposes 9 production keys: CareOps 3, Intake 2, Analytics 4).
- Include a 12-month price lock in the amendment covering the additional teams.
- Schedule a migration window for Analytics batch jobs the weekend of 7/24 to minimize customer impact.

Can Redwood confirm the 9 production keys + staged issuance (we will take the six suggested dev/test keys now)? Also, Jordan — can you provide the autoscale policy and a simple runbook we can hand to our SREs for the 7/24 migration?

If that sounds right we'll route the amendment for signature next week.

Best,
Tamara Chen
Director of Product, PulseCare
